INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_TARGET.disposition: The source citation is preserved and its target is absent. The manuscript does not identify an unambiguous replacement.

REPEATED_SOURCE_PASSAGE.disposition: Both passages occur in the original PDF. Removing or relocating either needs author confirmation.

LEGACY_BOOK_NAME.disposition: The legacy name occurs in the source itself. Rewriting prose requires an approved title and verse mapping.

PUNCTUATION_REVIEW.disposition: The punctuation is present in the PDF. Source preservation alone cannot establish whether it is intentional or erroneous.

INFERRED_SOURCE_LINE_JOIN.disposition: The PDF confirms the line break at the dash, but cannot establish the intended spacing. Keep the inference flagged.
